note: RED AT BUILD, NOT to-write: the instrument EXISTS, RUNS AND REPORTS. `instrument_currency_check.sh` is written and driven; red is the verdict, not the absence of one. It measures ONE NECESSARY CONDITION -- can the artefact an instrument drives see a change under test, by CONTENT -- and censuses who asks at all. The criterion asks that every instrument DEMONSTRATE it; a mechanism nothing calls has not required anything, so the row cannot be green while 0 instruments call it. THE FIRST RUN FOUND A LIVE INSTANCE, which is why this is red rather than theoretical: the DELIVERED binaries -- `~/.local/bin/intent` and `intentd` symlink into `target/release/` -- are BLIND to `db3f947a`, 14 commits behind HEAD, while the debug builds of the same tree carry it. CENSUS over the 20 instruments that drive an artefact: 0 demonstrate currency by content, 6 read the PROVENANCE PIN only (the answer AC-00.14 rules insufficient), 14 ask nothing. THE PROBE IS DERIVED, NOT DECLARED, because a hardcoded probe rots exactly like its subjects -- it is the newest commit yielding a shipping literal, and the run prints how far behind HEAD that is. NO DESIGNATED REFERENCE BINARY: 'the probe must match a known-current artefact' is circular and fails in the direction that matters, since a stale reference admits only probes it already carries and certifies staleness as currency. The control is two-sided instead -- the probe must be shown able to match SOMETHING -- and the tool exits 2 rather than reporting a clean sweep when it matches nothing, because from inside it 'every artefact is stale' and 'this literal never ships' are one observation. AND THE FIRST DERIVATION WAS WRONG IN THIS ROW'S OWN CLASS: it drew literals from colocated `#[cfg(test)]` modules (`mcp.rs:1260` encloses `:1266` and `:1310`), which ship in no binary ever built, so it reported 11 of 11 probes absent and every artefact stale -- a confident, well-formed verdict about a world that never existed, produced by the instrument built to catch exactly that. Caught by DRIVING the derivation before trusting it and by nothing else. MOVES when an instrument's report is conditioned on a currency demonstration rather than accompanied by one -- ie when a binary-driving instrument REFUSES to report against an artefact that cannot see its subject. Not when the census count rises: adoption is not requirement.
